process.title: How We Work
process.description: We make the remodeling process simple, clear, and easy to start.

steps.title: 1. Request a Quote
steps.description: Tell us what you need, where the project is located, and what area of your home you want to improve.

steps.title: 2. Share Your Project Details
steps.description: You can send photos, measurements, or a short description of the work you need done.

steps.title: 3. We Review the Project
steps.description: We evaluate the service, materials, timeline, and the best way to move forward.

steps.title: 4. We Schedule the Work
steps.description: Once everything is clear, we schedule your remodeling, installation, repair, or improvement service.

steps.title: 5. We Complete the Job
steps.description: Our team works with care, attention to detail, and respect for your home.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Castellanos Tile and Remodeling Services?
whyChooseUs.description: Choosing the right remodeling team matters. You need someone who understands your project, communicates clearly, respects your home, and pays attention to the details that make the final result look right.

faq.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request a free quote by filling out the form or calling us directly.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We serve Dallas, TX and nearby areas including Fort Worth, Arlington, Plano, Frisco, Irving, Garland, Mesquite, and surrounding cities.

faq.question: What types of remodeling projects do you handle?
faq.answer: We help with bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, tile installation, flooring, roofing, drywall, painting, fences, pressure washing, and more.

faq.question: Can I send photos of my project?
faq.answer: Yes. Sending photos helps us better understand your project before providing the next steps.

faq.question: Do you work on both interior and exterior projects?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide interior and exterior home improvement services.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Call us at (469) 890-5161 or fill out the quote form with your project details.
